items.name: Catch & Shoot: Fishing Game
items.description:
Catch the fish. Watch it jump. Take the shot.

Catch & Shoot: Fishing Game brings fishing and midair target shooting together in short 3D sessions. Cast your line, hold to reel in a fish and manage the line tension. When it leaps from the water, aim and shoot before it gets away.

Discover 10 different fish and fill your Fish Collection. Each new catch reveals a collection card, while repeat catches add to your total and bring you closer to unlocking another weapon.

items.name: Bad Pig House
items.description:
A twisted and hilarious take on the classic Three Little Pigs story.

Every day you have only one minute to gather resources, build your house, and prepare for the coming night.

When darkness falls...

The Crazy Wolf arrives.

He smashes walls, breaks doors, and will stop at nothing to get inside.

How many nights can you survive?

Welcome to Happy Trays, the sushi sort puzzle where every roll finds its tray!

Tap a plate of sushi rolls to send it to the sushi bar. The knife slices each roll, and every slice goes to the customer whose tray matches its color. Fill every tray, keep the line moving and serve every hungry customer.

items.name: Warlords of the Three Kingdoms
items.description:
The Han is falling. Warlords carve the land. Your first duty is to put down the Yellow Turbans.

Warlords of the Three Kingdoms is a text RPG for the few minutes you have: run a campaign, collect from your cities and territories, raid a rival, and the day's orders are done.

Eat. Grow. Swallow smaller snakes. Beat the boss!

「ふたり麻雀」は、2人で楽しめる17歩ルールをベースにした麻雀ゲームです。

OLSSON är kortspelet där du ska bli av med alla dina kort och samtidigt få så få poäng som möjligt. Klassikern sedan 1989, nu i mobilen och på paddan. Roligare och elakare än vändåtta.

Every great club starts on a muddy neighbourhood pitch. Yours starts today.

In Kickoff Academy you are the owner and head coach of a small youth soccer academy. Build training stations on the pitch, watch the kids practise, keep the parents happy and turn raw talent into real players. The game plays fully offline, needs no account and shows no ads.

Furtress is a tower defense game about cats guarding the pantry. The mice are after the cheese, and only your cats stand in their way.
